title: A saturated auxiliary reference realizes finite resolvent filters
statement: For the stated saturated auxiliary-reference pair, the entropy Hessian is an exact weighted resolvent integral; every finite simple-resolvent sum is realizable, and a normalized concentrating family recovers the SLD kernel in the necessity direction.

requires: Finite-dimensional channel pair and faithful baseline/tangent on the input including any original reference.
Saturated auxiliary pair with a centre and finitely many leaves as in N675 Section 2.2.
provides: Exact denominator Hessian as a sum of |K_ij|^2 weighted resolvent integrals.
A finite realizable filter family concentrating at scalar spectral point 1.
assumptions: Finite-dimensional states and channels; faithful baselines; sufficiently small perturbation parameter; finite filter at every stage.
costs: Auxiliary reference dimension grows with filter order; finite but not bounded uniformly in the order.
contract.units: Finite-dimensional relative-entropy Hessian / SLD metric coefficient.
contract.obstruction: This selected filter supports only the order-equivalence proof in N966; it does not verify N675 hardness, compiler, or other claims.

evidence.range_scope: N675 extracted Section 2.3 resolvent filter identity and realizability
evidence.status: Exact selected source bytes; source-reported unless a version-bound review overlay states otherwise.

body: Receiving use in N966: the filter supplies the necessity step from conditional Umegaki order to complete equal-reference SLD order by testing the Hessian and taking the normalized concentrating limit.

review.scope: Only the selected Section 2 mechanism as used in N966; no N675 hardness/compiler acceptance.
